description: A yellow cloth lies spread out on the left, and a neat stack of small folded cloths in pink, blue, and green sits on the right. Both hands pinch and fold a pink cloth into a tighter square, with the left hand holding it steady while the right hand tucks an edge inward, then the left hand carries the folded pink cloth rightward and sets it neatly on top of the stack, releasing it while the right hand hovers nearby.
